title: Denis Rajčić - Videos
description:
Balkanac, Stand Up komičar i fitness coach u potrazi za ''Američkim snom''.

Dobro došli na moj kanal na kojem vas želim zabaviti, nasmijati te podijeliti savjete o fitnessu, treningu i zdravom načinu života!

To sam spojio u svoj brand TRENIRAJ UZ OSMIJEH. #trenirajuzosmijeh

Obožavam nasmijavati i zabavljati ljude, trenirati (sebe i druge) i pisati (o vježbanju, zdravom životu, radu na sebi).

Ako vas zanima više o meni imate na 
https://www.denisrajcic.com/o-meni-denis-rajcic/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
My name is Denis Rajčić and this channel is about everything that I LOVE to do and what I'm living for: fitness training & healthy living, stand up comedy & acting.

I want you to inspire, educate & motivate YOU to live YOUR dreams and become the best version of YOURSELF.

Follow me and let's go together on this CRAZY & BEAUTIFUL journey which is called LIFE!
